test_title: RRB Technician Grade III 2025 (Exam Day Practice): General Intelligence & Reasoning
subject: reasoning
question: In the following question, four number pairs are given. The number on left side of (-) is related to the number of the right side of (-) with some Logic/Rule/Relation. Three are similar on basis of same Logic/Rule/Relation. Select the odd one out from the given alternatives.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1st Number – 2nd number = 23

Option (1) 167 – 144 → 167 – 144 = 23

Option (2) 132 – 109 → 132 – 109 = 23

Option (3) 182 – 159 → 182 - 159 = 23

Option (4) **144 – 120** → 144 – 120 = 24 ≠ 23

Hence, “144 – 120” is an odd one.
